name: Map
description: An interactive map with category colours and icons, a floating place list, photos, and detailed place information.

title.description: Collection heading and document title. An empty or omitted value uses the fallback heading and document title defined by the page.

subtitle.description: Optional supporting line below the map heading.

numbered.description: Show the one-based sorted position on pins and in the list.

basemap.description: Stored map layer. Hybrid adds Esri boundaries and place labels to satellite imagery.

sidebar.description: Stored sidebar visibility. The sidebar is hidden when there are no valid places; the viewer can change visibility locally.

categories.description: Optional category definitions keyed by stable letter-prefixed IDs. Place category fields refer to these keys. Without categories, places use the theme accent colour and pin glyph, with no category pill.

places.description: Places keyed by stable letter-prefixed IDs, such as place-01. Omission or an empty object shows the empty state.

name.description: Category label shown in the list and details and matched by the place filter.

icon.description: Default icon for places in this category. A place icon can override it.

color.description: Category colour from the Television foundation palette. If omitted, the page assigns colours to categories lacking an explicit colour in sorted-key order, cycling through the enum; explicit colours do not consume slots.

title.description: Place name in the list, pin label, and details. An absent later value uses the untitled-place fallback defined by the page.

order.description: Sort ascending; omitted values come last. Keys break ties. Displayed numbers use the sorted position, not this value.

icon.description: Override the category icon for a place with a known category. Unknown or omitted categories use pin. Numbered mode displays the sorted number instead.

category.description: A key in the optional categories map. A missing categories map or an omitted or unknown key is uncategorised, using the theme accent colour and pin glyph with no category pill. Explicit neutral categories use the neutral palette colour.

description.description: Optional place description shown in the list and details.

photo.description: An HTTPS URL or path inside the artifact folder. Relative paths may start with ./ and cannot contain edge whitespace, dot segments, percent escapes, query strings, or fragments.

text.description: Full photo credit, including the creator and licence where required.

url.description: HTTPS link to the photo source or licence.

fields.description: Detail labels mapped to any JSON values. Arrays and objects are serialized; empty values use the empty-value fallback defined by the page.
